notes:
Top-line: mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood. Started on Hosted API to validate latency/cost for support-agent + doc-search; results: hosted API p95 latency ~120ms for short chat  max_tokens 512, embedding costs higher than expected at current traffic pattern. Customer wants Dedicated to hit predictable throughput and reduced per-token cost for heavy embedding/rerank workloads.

POC scope (agreed): 4-week Dedicated trial with production-like traffic (shadow for 2 days, 10% canary for 5 days, ramp to 50% then 100% if metrics stable). Canary plan: start 10% user traffic -> monitor p95 latency, error-rate, token cost. Fallback routing: primary Dedicated pool in us-east-1, fallback to Redwood hosted_api in us-east-1 then to eu-west-1 hosted variant if region degradation. Model variants: prod-v1 (fp16), prod-q4_8 (quantized) as cheaper fallback; rerank uses smaller rerank-2 model for high-throughput paths.

Rollback criteria (agreed draft): sustained p95 latency >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate >2% for 5 consecutive minutes OR token cost anomaly >30% above baseline for 1 hour -> immediate automated rollback to previous model variant + route traffic to hosted_api. SRE wants concrete SLA for VPC peering (IP ranges + egress) before we start canary.

Procurement: procurement team needs committed pricing for 6/12-month Dedicated with burst credits. Revenue ops requested TCO comparison sheet (we provided drive:/decks/harborlight-redwood-pricing-v2.pdf).

Quoted customer feedback: "We like the unified API and the ability to pin model versions — big win for our product cycles." — Jordan (Head of Data).
